readme: [![Telegram Channel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-Channel-blue.svg?logo=telegram)](https://t.me/fkiab) [![Latest Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.fuck.iab?display_name=release&label=Latest%20Release&color=%23ff9000 )](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.fuck.iab/releases/latest) # FKIAB An Xposed module for hooking and customizing in-app billing functionality. ## Showcase https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/baa25c2c-baaf-4e84-86e8-51e9f4545a4a ## Compatibility - [x] Google Play Store - [x] Bazaar (Iranian App Market) - [x] Myket (Iranian App Market) - [ ] Samsung - [ ] Amazon - [ ] Huawei ## Features - Support for restoring previously purchased items. - Custom Frida Scripts. ## Custom Frida Scripts Some apps aren't supported by the module because they either verify purchase signatures locally or validate them through their own servers. These apps require custom scripts to bypass their specific verification methods. ``` scripts/src/ ├── global.js ├── com.kiloo.subwaysurf.js └── com.PoxelStudios.DudeTheftAuto.js ``` `global.js` is loaded for every app, before anything else. If a matching `.js` file also exists, it runs right after the global script. ### Custom Script Examples - Subway Surfers `com.kiloo.subwaysurf` - Ultimate USB `com.mixapplications.ultimateusb` - Bike Race `com.topfreegames.bikeracefreeworld` ### Contributing Custom Scripts Want to add support for another game or app? Feel free to open a pull request with a custom script. Scripts should only focus on bypassing purchase checks. Please include: - The package name of the app/game - The custom script - A brief description of what it does ## Telegram Channel Join the FKIAB Telegram channel to get notified as soon as a new release is available: https://t.me/fkiab ## Disclaimer This project is provided for educational and research purposes only. Use it responsibly and only on applications and environments you own or have permission to test. The authors and contributors are not responsible for any misuse, damage, or violations caused by using this project. Please respect developers, software licenses, and platform rules. --- **Feel free to open an issue if you have any problems or suggestions.**
readmeZh: [![电报频道](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-Channel-blue.svg?logo=telegram)](https://t.me/fkiab) [![最新版本](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.fuck.iab?display_name=release&label=Latest%20Release&color=%23ff9000 )](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.fuck.iab/releases/latest) #FKIAB 用于挂钩和自定义应用内计费功能的 Xposed 模块。 ## 展示 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/baa25c2c-baaf-4e84-86e8-51e9f4545a4a ## 兼容性 - [x] Google Play 商店 - [x] Bazaar（伊朗应用市场） - [x] Myket（伊朗应用市场） - [ ] 三星 - [ ] 亚马逊 - [ ] 华为 ## 特点 - 支持恢复以前购买的物品。 - 自定义弗里达脚本。 ## 自定义 Frida 脚本 该模块不支持某些应用程序，因为它们要么在本地验证购买签名，要么通过自己的服务器验证它们。这些应用程序需要自定义脚本来绕过其特定的验证方法。 ```` 脚本/src/ ├── 全局.js ├── com.kiloo.subwaysurf.js └── com.PoxelStudios.DudeTheftAuto.js ```` 每个应用程序都会首先加载“global.js”。如果匹配的“.js”文件也存在，它将在全局脚本之后立即运行。 ### 自定义脚本示例 - 地铁跑酷`com.kiloo.subwaysurf` - 终极 USB `com.mixapplications.ultimateusb` - 自行车比赛`com.topfreegames.bikeracefreeworld` ### 贡献自定义脚本 想要添加对其他游戏或应用程序的支持吗？请随意使用自定义脚本打开拉取请求。 脚本应该只专注于绕过购买检查。 请包括： - 应用程序/游戏的包名称 - 自定义脚本 - 对其作用的简要描述 ## 电报频道 加入 FKIAB Telegram 频道，以便在新版本发布后立即收到通知：https://t.me/fkiab ## 免责声明 该项目仅用于教育和研究目的。负责任地使用它，并且仅在您拥有或有权测试的应用程序和环境中使用它。作者和贡献者对因使用本项目而造成的任何误用、损坏或违规不承担任何责任。请尊重开发者、软件许可和平台规则。 --- **如果您有任何问题或建议，请随时提出问题。**
